mapper.delete: DELETE FROM workspaces WHERE workspace_id=#{workspaceId} AND revision=#{expectedRevision} AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM threads WHERE workspace_id=#{workspaceId} AND deleted_at IS NULL)
mapper.select: SELECT thread_id,workspace_id,title,provider_id,model_id,reasoning_level,access_mode,title_source, revision,created_at,updated_at,archived_at,deleted_at FROM threads WHERE thread_id=#{threadId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE threads SET revision=revision+1,updated_at=#{occurredAt} WHERE thread_id=#{threadId} AND revision=#{expectedRevision} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: UPDATE threads SET revision=revision+1,updated_at=#{occurredAt} WHERE thread_id=#{threadId} AND deleted_at IS NULL RETURNING revision
mapper.update: UPDATE threads SET revision=revision+1,updated_at=#{occurredAt} WHERE thread_id=#{threadId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT thread_id,workspace_id,title,provider_id,model_id,reasoning_level,access_mode,title_source, revision,created_at,updated_at,archived_at,deleted_at FROM threads WHERE workspace_id=#{workspaceId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND (updated_at<#{cursorTime} OR (updated_at=#{cursorTime} AND thread_id<#{cursorId})) ORDER BY updated_at DESC,thread_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT thread_id,workspace_id,title,provider_id,model_id,reasoning_level,access_mode,title_source, revision,created_at,updated_at,archived_at,deleted_at FROM threads WHERE workspace_id=#{workspaceId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND instr(lower(title),#{normalizedQuery})>0 AND (updated_at<#{cursorTime} OR (updated_at=#{cursorTime} AND thread_id<#{cursorId})) ORDER BY updated_at DESC,thread_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE threads SET provider_id=#{providerId},model_id=#{modelId},reasoning_level=#{reasoningLevel}, access_mode=#{accessMode}, title=#{provisionalTitle}, revision=revision+1,updated_at=#{occurredAt} WHERE thread_id=#{threadId} AND revision=#{expectedRevision} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND title_source='PLACEHOLDER'

UPDATE threads SET deleted_at=#{occurredAt},SET archived_at=#{occurredAt}, revision=revision+1,updated_at=#{occurredAt} WHERE thread_id=#{threadId} AND revision=#{expectedRevision} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM turns WHERE thread_id=#{threadId} AND state IN ('QUEUED','RUNNING','WAITING_APPROVAL')

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT item_id,'message' AS item_kind,created_at,turn_id,NULL AS call_id,NULL AS tool_name, NULL AS tool_ordinal,NULL AS tool_state,message_kind,public_text,model_round,NULL AS presentation_json, NULL AS approval_id,NULL AS decision, NULL AS expires_at,NULL AS attachment_id,NULL AS display_name,NULL AS size_bytes,NULL AS media_kind, NULL AS media_type,NULL AS attachment_state FROM timeline_messages WHERE thread_id=#{threadId} UNION ALL SELECT call_id||'_call','tool_call',created_at,turn_id,call_id,tool_name,ordinal,state, NULL,NULL,NULL,presentation_json,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL FROM tools WHERE thread_id=#{threadId} UNION ALL SELECT a.approval_id,'approval',a.requested_at,a.turn_id,a.call_id,t.tool_name,NULL,NULL, NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,a.approval_id,a.decision,a.expires_at,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL FROM approvals a JOIN tools t ON t.turn_id=a.turn_id AND t.call_id=a.call_id WHERE a.thread_id=#{threadId} UNION ALL SELECT ta.attachment_id||'_attachment','attachment',ta.created_at,ta.turn_id, NULL,NULL,ta.ordinal,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,a.attachment_id,a.display_name,a.size_bytes, lower(a.media_kind),a.media_type,lower(a.status) FROM turn_attachments ta JOIN turns t ON t.turn_id=ta.turn_id JOIN attachments a ON a.attachment_id=ta.attachment_id WHERE t.thread_id=#{threadId} ) items WHERE created_at>#{cursorTime} OR (created_at=#{cursorTime} AND item_id>#{cursorId}) ORDER BY created_at,item_id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT artifact_id,content,byte_length FROM change_set_artifacts WHERE thread_id=#{threadId} AND turn_id=#{turnId} AND artifact_id=#{artifactId}
